LanguageData.Raven_Item_HypnosisApp.label: [Raven] Hypnosis App Device
LanguageData.Raven_Item_HypnosisApp.description:
A portable terminal loaded with an illegal software called "Crimson Dream". It is a single-use consumable.

When used, aim it at the target to perform a "biometric lock". Once successfully locked, the user's biological waves will establish a permanent "Hypnotic Link" with the target's subconscious.

Afterward, the user can use the terminal's background privileges to force the target to execute specific physical commands anytime, anywhere.
